title: Launch HN: BitBoard (YC P25) – Analytics Workspace for Agents
originalTitle: Launch HN: BitBoard (YC P25) – Analytics Workspace for Agents
content:
Build dashboards and reports with your favorite AI tools.

Connect your data, build with your agent, share with your team.

Use from your favorite AI tools.

Generate dashboards and analysis in BitBoard from your favorite AI chat or coding agent. Turn your analysis into connected, durable assets instead of one-off chat threads.

Traceable and repeatable.

Connections, queries, and code are stored. Know exactly where your data came from and can rerun with consistent logic, even if the logic was AI-generated.

All your data, in one place.

Give BitBoard direct access to your data sources for live connections or push data from your agent to leverage existing connections with minimal setup.

Share with your team.

Use AI for data analysis without losing logic and context in your chat threads. Share with your team and collaborate in the browser.

Try BitBoard for free.
